T3 has no stored v3 field, so v3_last is recomputed with rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text). rln4_grader_v3.py named in the recipe calls the same function (R.grade_v3). An empty extraction counts 0. Some rows have empty text (n_new 0). They are not self-opened, get v3_last 0 and no marker, so they stay in the denominator with first_score 0, as the recipe says. Self-opened means '\nOkay' is a substring of text[:60], so the match must end inside the first 60 characters. Main first marker: the first line whose lstrip() starts with case-sensitive 'Answer:' (content = rest of that line, which may be empty, and then grading 'Answer: ' gives 0), or the first '\boxed{' (brace-balanced content, else rest of text), whichever starts earlier. first_score = grade_v3(gold, 'Answer: ' + content). If the content is multi-line (an unbalanced box), v3 re-extracts inside it and may pick a later box or marker inside that content. alt_measured: the first marker is grader v3's own first candidate: a MARK_V3 match anywhere in a line ('Answer:', 'Final Answer:', 'Answer is', bold variants) with a non-empty rest of line, or the first balanced box, whichever starts earlier. The interval is a bootstrap over the filtered rows (the denominator), so it is conditional on the filter.

Same file, dedup, self-opened rule, v3_last and first-marker definitions as p1 (see k 1). Cap hits are included. Empty-text rows have first_score 0 and v3_last 0, so they are never discordant. Discordant means first_score != v3_last. Statistic: share of discordant rows with first_score 1. alt_measured is the same statistic with the v3-candidate first marker (see k 1); its discordant set is recomputed and can differ in size from the main one. n is the number of discordant rows under the main reading. The bootstrap resamples over discordant rows. The discordant set may be small, which gives a wide interval.

Same file, dedup and self-opened rule as p1. Kept rows: cap_hit is False (a row with a missing or null cap_hit is dropped) and v3_last == 0. Empty-text rows are kept (finish 'stop', cap_hit false) and count as not run-on, so they lower the share. End of the first marker: for an 'Answer:' line, the position of the newline that ends it (the remaining text starts with that newline); for a box, just after the matching '}', or end of text if unbalanced. Run-on: the remaining text is more than 300 characters (len > 300) and either one of its lines (split on '\n') starts after lstrip() with 'Answer:', or it contains '\boxed{'. When the first marker is a box, the first 'line' of the remaining text is the rest of the box's line, and it counts if it starts with 'Answer:'. alt_measured: the v3-candidate first marker and, for 'another marker', any v3 candidate (MARK_V3 anywhere in a line with a non-empty rest, or a balanced box) in the remaining text. The bootstrap resamples over kept rows.
